name: zed2cli
description: Use Zed-hosted AI models from opencode, pi, hermes, or any OpenAI-compatible CLI through your Zed subscription — without running Zed.
author: 6yte96

scripts.prepublishOnly: node --check cli.mjs && node --check src/index.mjs && node --check src/index.v1.mjs && node --check src/models.mjs && node --check src/proxy.mjs && node --check src/pi/zed-ai.mjs && node scripts/check-models.mjs && bash -n scripts/*.sh
